confidence.description: Probability that the decision is correct, 0.0 to 1.0.

project_type.description: Short English label, e.g. 'commercial renovation', 'new build', 'tree removal'.

matched_services.description: Subset of the company's services. Empty if none apply.

evidence.description: Exact copy of one phrase or sentence from the notice body, in Dutch. Never paraphrase, translate or shorten with ellipses. Required for every decision.

reason.description: One English sentence explaining the decision.
